title: Report Card Scoring
text: every indicator 0-1 outcome, three functions combine increasingly aggregated scores. diagram shows full hierarchy single bay segment/year: category’s indicators (named ’re passed anlz_indicators()/anlz_category() ) funnel category’s score, four category scores funnel single overall score.     anlz_indicators() stacks number named indicator data.frames one long table (bay_segment, yr, indicator, outcome), without filling gaps indicator data given segment/year. anlz_category() calls anlz_indicators() internally, averages outcome within bay segment/year get category score - result also keeps one wide column per indicator, indicators behind category score stay visible alongside . anlz_score() thin wrapper around anlz_category(): four category scores just another set “indicators” average, giving overall bay segment score.

code: # continuous, e.g. TBNI scores from 0-100 util_outcome(c(20, 46, 90), type = 'continuous', from = c(0, 100)) #> [1] 0.20 0.46 0.90  # continuous with a narrower transition window, e.g. TBNI's 32-46 # breakpoints - values outside the window are clamped to 0/1 util_outcome(c(20, 32, 39, 46, 60), type = 'continuous', from = c(32, 46)) #> [1] 0.0 0.0 0.5 1.0 1.0  # threshold, e.g. chlorophyll attainment (lower is better) - smooth by # default, a logistic transition rather than a hard cutoff util_outcome(c(5, 10, 15), type = 'threshold', thresh = 10) #> [1] 0.993307149 0.500000000 0.006692851  # a larger pct widens the transition (steepness relative to thresh) util_outcome(12, type = 'threshold', thresh = 10, pct = 0.1) #> [1] 0.1192029 util_outcome(12, type = 'threshold', thresh = 10, pct = 0.2) #> [1] 0.2689414  # smooth = "none" (or FALSE) instead gives a hard 0/1 cutoff util_outcome(c(5, 15), type = 'threshold', thresh = 10, op = '<', smooth = 'none') #> [1] 1 0  # smooth = "ramp": meeting/beating a target (op = ">=") is full credit, # decaying toward 0 the further short of it a value falls util_outcome(c(90, 95, 100, 105), type = 'threshold', thresh = 100, op = '>=', smooth = 'ramp') #> [1] 0.3678794 0.6065307 1.0000000 1.0000000  # category, e.g. FIB grades util_outcome(c('A', 'C', 'E'), type = 'category',   levels = c(A = 1, B = 0.75, C = 0.5, D = 0.25, E = 0)) #> [1] 1.0 0.5 0.0
